acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Burrowers family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Tremor Worm, T4, rather than another family form.
Communicates the False-Ridge Champion archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two wind construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Thick armored middle rings, vibration feelers, scarred dorsal plates, and a hammer-shaped terminal tail.
Signature mechanic: False Tremors: three dust ridges advance, but only the true route moves embedded stones and ends in a body roll.
battlefieldDuty: Produce several decoy ridges while its heavy body travels beneath one real route, then erupt into a sweeping roll.
constructionDimensions: Segment edges trail directional dust filaments and the body briefly dissipates only at the moving outer contour while retaining an opaque core.
Pressure ripples flatten surface dust ahead of the real ridge and curl inward at eruption points.
counterplay: Track the embedded stones, evade that eruption, and punish the hammer tail left above ground after the roll. Affinity signal: The pressure wake collapses at the exposed tail, jaw hinge, or collar when the Burrower stops to commit.
forbiddenTreatments: Pressure effects that make false and real ridges indistinguishable
identityInvariants: Every form retains a limbless segmented body, armored digging front, softer articulated rear, tactile sensory organs, and soil-displacing locomotion.
Tier is shown through mandible specialization, segment reinforcement, collar structure, tail shape, and tunneling behavior rather than humanoid traits.
The real underground route and the exposed punish segment always have physical environmental tells.
telegraph: False ridges shed loose dust while the real ridge displaces stones from below.
